title: Golden Milk (Haldi Doodh)
description: A traditional Ayurvedic bedtime tonic combining turmeric with warm milk and black pepper to maximize curcuminoid bio-availability.

preparationSteps.instruction: Warm 200ml milk on gentle medium heat.
Whisk in 1 tsp turmeric powder and a pinch of black pepper.

title: Tulsi Respiratory Kadha
description: Rejuvenating decoction of fresh Tulsi leaves boiled with ginger to soothe sore throat and ease respiratory congestion.

preparationSteps.instruction: Boil crushed leaves in 2 cups of clean water until reduced to 1 cup.

contraindications: Consult physician before combined use with blood-thinners
